stepNotes.7: smoke.test.ts:364-388 covers one explicit-ID happy path and breakdown.test.ts:27-168 covers renderer arithmetic; no test covers empty/missing/default selection, 1,000-row truncation, multi-turn cached usage, tool parts, or the explicit-session footer.
